content:
Hi all,

Sharing two Lean 4 projects that I recently put together, covering coincidence index bounds and orthogonal graph rigidity:

  1. Coincidence index and support bound ($m \le 2\Sigma$)
    Formalizes the sharp inequality $m \le 2\Sigma$ for rational orthogonal matrices (where $m$ is the nonintegral core order and $\Sigma$ is the coincidence index). Also covers coordinate root systems ($A_{k-1}, D_l$) and character energy estimates.
  • Code: https://github.com/Juemian-Deng/coincidence-index-lean
  • Preprint: https://github.com/Juemian-Deng/coincidence-index-lean/blob/main/Coincidence_index_and_support_v1.pdf
  1. Adaptive real orthogonal rigidity on random graphs
    Formalizes support and rank constraints on real orthogonal witnesses under adaptive graph observation.
  • Code: https://github.com/Juemian-Deng/adaptive-orthogonal-rigidity
  • Preprint: https://github.com/Juemian-Deng/adaptive-orthogonal-rigidity/blob/main/Quantitative_orthogonal_rigidity_Deng_v1_2026-10-12.pdf

Both build cleanly on Lean 4.34.1 with zero sorry, using standard axioms only (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound).

Would appreciate any feedback, especially on formalization structure, typeclass design, or connections to related mathlib developments.
